# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a sister named Tibby and other family members residing in Brierley. She is part of a large local family, with four Tulk families living in the area.

_Sources: [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Flossie is straightforward, outspoken, and quick to ask direct or intrusive questions without hesitation. She tends to harbor a superstitious mindset, believing in bad luck associated with specific numbers like thirteen. Although she can be condescending and critical toward others—such as mocking classmates' creative ambitions or charity-dependent backgrounds—she is capable of showing friendliness, even if her compliments carry a patronizing tone.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)_

## Traits

- outspoken and direct  <sub>[v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031)</sub>
- superstitious  <sub>[v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007)</sub>
- patronizing  <sub>[v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)</sub>
- critical  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- to gain a college education without needing it for a future livelihood

## History

Flossie Tulk attended Brierley School under the instruction of Miss Thorne, where she engaged in physical culture routines and recitations, though she openly expressed a strong dislike for the recitation sessions. She later traveled to the Academy alongside classmates including Nell Harcourt, Odette Pullen, and Opal Pettigrew to sit for entrance exams, remarking on Nell's pale appearance and expressing doubts about her ability to endure the teacher's course. During her studies, she shared her view that she attended college solely to gain an education, since her family's financial position meant she would not need to earn a living. Later, Flossie attended a send-off celebration hosted at her family's spacious home by the B.V.I.S. to honor Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow, where she acted remarkably friendly and patronizingly complimented Nell on her dress.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002), [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)_
